Let \(f\) be the function given by \(f(x)=4 x^{2}-x^{3}\), and let \(\ell\) be the line \(y=18-3 x\), where \(\ell\) is tangent to the
graph of \(f\). Let \(R\) be the region bounded by the graph of \(f\) and the \(x\)-axis, and let \(S\) be the region bounded by
the graph of \(f\), the line \(\ell\), and the \(x\)-axis, as shown above.
(a) Show that \(\ell\) is tangent to the graph of \(y=f(x)\) at the point \(x=3\).
(b) Find the area of \(S\).
(c) Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is revolved about the \(x\)-axis.
